description: This file defines a SpiderApp class for interacting with a web crawling API, including methods for scraping URLs and starting crawl jobs, along with related interfaces and error handling.

classes.name: SpiderApp
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with the Spider cloud crawling API, including URL scraping and crawl job management.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SpiderApp with API key and URL, throws error if API key is missing.

methods.name: scrapeUrl
methods.description: Performs a web scrape of the specified URL, returning the response data or error.

methods.name: crawlUrl
methods.description: Starts a crawl job for the specified URL, returning success status and data.

methods.name: prepareHeaders
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers including authorization and optional idempotency key.

methods.name: postRequest
methods.description: Sends a POST request to the specified API endpoint with given data and headers.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles API response errors based on status codes, throwing detailed errors.
